meta.title: chore: Shared Types Package — Deduplicate ValueOf/Result/Brand
meta.body:
### Overview
Pre-BRIEF-3 cleanup: a shared **types-only** workspace package (`packages/types`) so every package stops re-declaring `ValueOf`/`Result`/`Brand`/`MaybePromise` locally. Zero runtime exports and zero dependencies — the guarantee that makes it safe for `github` (no-DB-imports rule) and everyone else to depend on. Room for shared domain types later.

Stacked on #27 (PR D of the BRIEF-2 stack); retarget to main as the stack merges.

### Changelog
- New `packages/types` (lib.ts + AGENTS.md documenting the types-only/zero-deps invariants)
- persistence: imports + re-exports the shared types; public contract unchanged; crypto.ts local `MaybePromise` removed
- github: `src/types.ts` becomes a re-export; AGENTS.md local-copies rule rewritten
- api: `RefreshErrorCode` uses `ValueOf`
- apps/web: `brief/types.ts` re-exports `ValueOf` (existing `./types` import sites unchanged)
- CI: `packages/types/` changes trigger all dependent package jobs

index 00000000..ebd478d6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/types/AGENTS.md
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+# packages/types — agent notes
+
+The shared TYPE-ONLY utility package: `ValueOf`, `Result`, `Brand`,
+`MaybePromise`. Every workspace package imports these from here instead of
+re-declaring local copies.
+
+## Invariants (enforced, don't weaken)
+
+- **Types only, zero runtime.** Nothing here may emit JavaScript — no values,
+  no functions, no classes, no `const`. If a helper needs runtime behavior it
+  does NOT belong in this package.
+- **Zero dependencies.** `package.json` has no `dependencies`, ever. This is
+  what makes the package safe for every other package — including `github`,
+  whose no-DB-imports rule forbids runtime coupling to `persistence` — to
+  depend on.
+- **Domain types stay in their domains.** Concrete branded id families
+  (`InstallationId`, `RepoId`, ...) and their runtime guards live in
+  `persistence`; only the generic `Brand` mechanism lives here. Closed
+  vocabularies (`PrState`, ...) stay with their owning package.
+
+## Conventions
+
+Named exports only; extensionless relative imports; strict TS. Same doc-comment
+style as the rest of the repo: say WHY the type exists, not just what it is.
+
+## Verification
+
+```sh
+pnpm -C packages/types typecheck
+```

+// Shared TYPE-ONLY utilities. This package is the single home for the
+// utility types every workspace package used to re-declare locally.
+//
+// HARD INVARIANT — types only, zero runtime, zero dependencies: nothing in
+// this package may emit JavaScript (no values, no functions, no classes) and
+// `package.json` must never grow a dependency. That guarantee is what makes it
+// safe for EVERY package to depend on — including `github`, whose no-DB-
+// imports rule exists precisely to avoid runtime coupling to `persistence`.
+// A type-only import graph cannot re-introduce that coupling.
+
+/**
+ * Union of a mapped type's value types. Used instead of `enum` for closed
+ * vocabularies: pair with an `as const` object map, e.g.
+ *   const Status = { PENDING: "pending", NOT_STARTED: "not-started" } as const;
+ *   type Status = ValueOf<typeof Status>;
+ */
+export type ValueOf<T> = T[keyof T];
+
+/**
+ * Discriminated union for EXPECTED failures (bad env, missing row, upstream
+ * refusal, ...). Reserve `throw` for programmer errors. Functions returning
+ * `Result` never throw for these paths.
+ */
+export type Result<T, E> =
+  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: T }
+  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: E };
+
+/**
+ * Nominal-typing helper: brands a primitive type `K` with a unique tag `T` so
+ * structurally identical values (e.g. two id `bigint`s) are not
+ * interchangeable at compile time. No runtime representation — `Brand` exists
+ * only in the type system. Concrete branded families (e.g. `InstallationId`)
+ * and their runtime guards live with their owning domain (`persistence`),
+ * NOT here; only the mechanism is shared.
+ */
+export type Brand<K, T> = K & { readonly __brand: T };
+
+/**
+ * `T | Promise<T>` — lets a seam accept sync and async implementations with
+ * one signature (e.g. an env-backed key provider today, a KMS-backed one
+ * later) while callers simply `await` either.
+ */
+export type MaybePromise<T> = T | Promise<T>;
